items.en: Zoology adopted the rank for the great body plans, while botany kept division for the same level.
items.cn: 动物学采用这个阶元来指几大身体构型，植物学则在同层级沿用 division（部）。

items.en: Sequence data forced many phylum boundaries to be redrawn, and some deep branches are now called phylum-level lineages before they are formally named.
items.cn: 序列数据迫使许多门界被重划；一些深层分支在正式命名之前就已被称作门级支系。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first English use of phylum as a rank is not fixed here, and the pre-Greek origin of phyein is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：phylum 作为阶元最早的英语使用此处无法确定；phyein 在希腊语之前的来源属重构形式。

note.en: Group one separates words built on the Greek phylon stock; group two compares the ranks around phylum.
note.cn: 第一组区分同出希腊 phylon 词干的词；第二组比较门周围的各个阶元。

entries.definition: The plural of phylum, formed on the Greek neuter pattern. It is the same rank in another number.
entries.definitionCN: phylum 的复数，按希腊中性模式构成。它是同一阶元的另一种数。

entries.definition: Relating to a phylum or to a line of descent, from Greek phyletikos. It describes lineage, not a rank.
entries.definitionCN: 与门或与一条血统线有关的，出自希腊 phyletikos。它描述谱系，而非阶元。

entries.definition: The evolutionary history of a group, from phylon plus genesis. It is the history that a phylum's name summarizes.
entries.definitionCN: 一个类群的演化史，由 phylon 加 genesis 构成。它是门名所概括的那段历史。

entries.definition: A common misspelling with an extra l, confusing phylum with Greek phyllon 'leaf'. It is not a word.
entries.definitionCN: 常见的多写一个 l 的拼错形式，把 phylum 与希腊 phyllon「叶」混淆。它不是词。

entries.definition: The botanical rank corresponding to phylum, used for plants and fungi; the two codes name one level differently.
entries.definitionCN: 植物与真菌中相当于门的等级；两套法规对同一层级用了不同名称。

entries.definition: The rank immediately below phylum; a phylum is divided into classes.
entries.definitionCN: 紧接在门之下的阶元；一个门被分为若干纲。

entries.definition: The rank above phylum in the traditional hierarchy; a kingdom contains several phyla.
entries.definitionCN: 传统层级中门之上的阶元；一个界包含若干门。

entries.definition: The overall architecture that defines a phylum; it is the evidence, while phylum is the rank.
entries.definitionCN: 界定一个门的整体构造；它是证据，而门是阶元。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: phylon was a tribe or stock: a phylum is one great stock of the living world.
normal.cn: phylon 是部落或种系：一个门就是生物界的一支大种系。

normal.en: The plural is phyla, on the Greek pattern, and technical writing keeps it.
normal.cn: 复数是 phyla，按希腊模式构成，技术写作沿用。

normal.en: Body plan, not breeding, defines the rank; that is why a phylum is so deep.
normal.cn: 界定这个阶元的是身体构型而非繁殖；这就是门如此深层的原因。

normal.en: Zoologists say phylum, botanists say division for the same level.
normal.cn: 同一层级，动物学家说 phylum，植物学家说 division。

normal.en: Phylum names have no fixed ending, unlike family names with -aceae or -idae.
normal.cn: 门名没有固定词尾，不像科名带 -aceae 或 -idae。

abstract.en: Picture a building whose foundations are poured once and never changed.
abstract.cn: 想象一座建筑，地基浇一次就再也不改。

abstract.en: Picture a tree so old that its first branches are thicker than the twigs at the top.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵老树，最初的分枝比树梢的细枝还粗。

abstract.en: Picture a map where the largest regions are drawn by hand and the small ones by rule.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，最大的区域靠手绘，小区域靠规则。

examples.en: Arthropods form the largest phylum in the animal kingdom.
examples.cn: 节肢动物构成动物界最大的门。

examples.en: The two groups were placed in one phylum only after their larvae were compared.
examples.cn: 这两个类群直到比较了幼体之后才被放进同一个门。

examples.en: Botanists call the same level a division, not a phylum.
examples.cn: 植物学家把同一层级称作部，而不是门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「phy 飞 + lum 来」——一大支一起飞来的族群 → phylum 门

root: 新拉丁语 phylum，取自希腊语 phylon「族、支系、种系」，出自 phyein「生长」；海克尔于 1866 年引入为阶元。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of phylum move from the rank itself to its body-plan criterion, the botanical equivalent, the plural, the teaching shortlist, molecular redrawing, the phylogenetic branch and the absence of a fixed ending.
sensesIntro.cn: phylum 的八个义项从阶元本身出发，依次是身体构型这一判据、植物学中的对应等级、复数、教学短名单、分子数据的重划、系统发生上的分支，以及固定词尾的缺席。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one deep foundation plan shared by many buildings, cut off from the rest of the city.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份被许多建筑共享的深层地基图，从城市其余部分被切分出来。

branches.en: THE RANK AND ITS TEST: a phylum is a great stock defined by architecture, not by breeding.
branches.cn: 阶元与判据：门是由构造而非繁殖界定的一支大种系。

branches.en: THE FORM: botanists say division for the same level, and the plural is phyla.
branches.cn: 形式：植物学家把同一层级称作部，复数则是 phyla。

branches.en: THE TEACHING SHORTLIST: a few familiar phyla stand for the whole diversity.
branches.cn: 教学短名单：少数熟悉的门代表全部多样性。

branches.en: THE REVISION: sequences reopen boundaries and reveal branches before anatomy is known.
branches.cn: 修订：序列重新打开界线，并在解剖结构已知之前揭示分支。

branches.en: NO FIXED ENDING: phylum names must be learned one by one because no code fixes their form.
branches.cn: 没有固定词尾：门名只能逐个记诵，因为法规不统一其形式。

intro.en: Phylum is Greek in origin and New Latin in form; its meaning is a stock or tribe, and its use is a rank.
intro.cn: phylum 源自希腊语、成形于新拉丁语；意义是种系或部落，用途是分类阶元。

latinIntro.en: There is no classical Latin noun phylum; the Latin entry is the New Latin rank term, while the Greek items are listed because they carry the meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 古典拉丁语没有 phylum 这一名词；拉丁词条列表所收为作为阶元术语的新拉丁语词，希腊成分则另列，因为它们承载词义。

items.example: Phylon supplies the sense of one great stock.
items.exampleCN: phylon 提供「一支大种系」的意思。

items.example: The stock is what has grown from one root.
items.exampleCN: 种系就是从一条根生长出来的东西。

items.meaning: a primary division of a kingdom
items.example: A phylum groups classes that share a body plan.
items.exampleCN: 门把共享身体构型的纲聚合起来。

items.example: Thirty-two phyla are recognized in animals.
items.exampleCN: 动物界现被承认三十二个门。

items.meaning: relating to a line of descent
items.example: Phyletic change is change along a lineage.
items.exampleCN: 谱系变化是沿一条血统线的变化。

items.example: Phylogeny is the history a phylum name summarizes.
items.exampleCN: 系统发生是门名所概括的历史。

items.example: Botany calls the same level a division.
items.exampleCN: 植物学把同一层级称作部。

items.example: A phylum divides into classes.
items.exampleCN: 一个门分为若干纲。

items.example: A kingdom contains several phyla.
items.exampleCN: 一个界包含若干门。

latinEntries.structure: phylum, phyli (n., New Latin, from Greek phylon)

definition_zh: 王国；界（生物分类最高传统阶元）；领域；天国
definition_en: a country ruled by a king or queen, or the highest traditional rank in biological classification
core_image: 老城堡的墙外是一片农田，城门上刻着国王的名字
scene: 老城堡的城墙外是一片农田，那是这个王国的土地，城门上刻着国王的名字。 Beyond the walls of the old castle lay the farmland of the kingdom, and the king's name was cut into the gate.
sceneCN: 这里 kingdom 是「王国」（第 1 个义项：由君主统治的国家）；句意：老城堡的墙外是一片农田，那是这个王国的土地，城门上刻着国王的名字。

pos.zh: 王国；（生物分类的）界；领域；天国

senses.title: A state ruled by a monarch
senses.definition: a country whose head of state is a king or queen, with the territory and people under that rule
senses.definitionCN: 以国王或女王为国家元首、拥有相应领土与人民的国家
senses.example: Beyond the walls lay the farmland of the kingdom.
senses.exampleCN: 城墙之外是这个王国的农田。
senses.why: The word is a native English compound: cyning 'king' plus -dom 'domain, jurisdiction', so kingdom is literally the area a king holds.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是英语本族复合词：cyning「国王」加 -dom「领域、管辖」，因此 kingdom 字面就是国王所辖之地。

senses.title: The highest traditional taxonomic rank
senses.titleCN: 传统分类中的最高阶元「界」
senses.definition: the broadest rank in the classical hierarchy, grouping phyla that share fundamental cellular organization
senses.definitionCN: 古典层级中最宽的阶元，把在基本细胞组织上相同的若干门聚合起来
senses.example: The animal kingdom contains more than thirty phyla.
senses.exampleCN: 动物界包含三十多个门。
senses.why: Taxonomy borrowed the political word for the widest realm: a kingdom of organisms is a territory with one kind of basic constitution.
senses.whyCN: 分类学借用了这个政治词来指最宽的领域：一个生物界就是一片具有同一种基本构造的领土。

senses.title: The five-kingdom system
senses.definition: the twentieth-century division of life into Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia
senses.definitionCN: 20 世纪把生命分为原核生物、原生生物、真菌、植物与动物的方案
senses.example: The five-kingdom system replaced a simple plant-or-animal split.
senses.exampleCN: 五界系统取代了简单的植物／动物二分。
senses.why: Five kingdoms became standard because microscopy revealed groups that were neither plant nor animal; the political word was simply multiplied to hold them.
senses.whyCN: 五界之所以成为标准，是因为显微技术揭示了既非植物也非动物的类群；人们只是把那个政治词复制成五个来容纳它们。

senses.title: The three-domain revision
senses.definition: the later scheme in which molecular data placed the kingdoms under three domains, demoting kingdom from the top rank
senses.definitionCN: 后来的方案：分子数据把各界归入三个域之下，界因此不再是最高阶元
senses.example: The three-domain scheme demoted the kingdom to a level below the domain.
senses.exampleCN: 三域方案把界降为域之下的一级。
senses.why: Once ribosomal sequences showed two great prokaryotic groups, the top of the ladder had to move up; a kingdom became a subdivision rather than the whole.
senses.whyCN: 当核糖体序列显示出两个巨大的原核类群，梯子的顶端就必须上移；界于是成为再分，而不再是整体。

senses.title: A figurative realm
senses.definition: a sphere in which something rules or prevails, as in a kingdom of ideas or a kingdom of silence
senses.definitionCN: 某物在其中统治或盛行的领域，如观念的国度、寂静的国度
senses.example: The library was a kingdom of silence.
senses.exampleCN: 那座图书馆是一个寂静的国度。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the political shape without the monarch: a realm with its own rule, its own borders and its own inhabitants.
senses.whyCN: 这个隐喻保留政治形状而抽掉君主：一个有自身规则、边界与居民的领域。

senses.title: The animal or plant kingdom in ordinary speech
senses.titleCN: 日常语中的动物界、植物界
senses.definition: an informal use of the rank in phrases such as the animal kingdom, often in nature writing and classrooms
senses.definitionCN: 「动物界」一类短语中对这个阶元的非正式使用，常见于自然写作与课堂
senses.example: The documentary toured the animal kingdom in six episodes.
senses.exampleCN: 这部纪录片用六集走遍动物界。
senses.why: Outside technical writing the rank is used as a vivid container: a kingdom is easier to picture than a phylum, so it carries popular science.
senses.whyCN: 在技术写作之外，这个阶元被当作一个生动的容器：界比门更容易想象，因此大众科普常用它。

senses.title: The Kingdom of God in theology
senses.definition: the rule or realm of God, a central image in Jewish and Christian teaching
senses.definitionCN: 上帝统治的领域，是犹太教与基督教教导中的核心意象
senses.example: The sermon compared the kingdom to a mustard seed.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇讲道把天国比作一粒芥菜种。
senses.why: Theological use is older than the biological one: a kingdom is where a sovereign's will is done, and the parable extends that to a rule that grows unseen.
senses.whyCN: 神学用法早于生物学用法：王国就是君主的意志得以施行之处，比喻则把它延伸到一种悄然生长的统治。

senses.title: Kant's kingdom of ends
senses.definition: the philosophical idea of a systematic union of rational beings under shared moral laws
senses.definitionCN: 理性存在者在共同道德法则下结成系统联合的哲学理念
senses.example: Kant asked what a kingdom of ends would require of each member.
senses.exampleCN: 康德追问目的王国会对每个成员提出什么要求。
senses.why: Philosophy used the political image for a community governed by law rather than by a person, which is the same structure with the ruler removed.
senses.whyCN: 哲学用这个政治意象指由法则而非由人统治的共同体，正是去掉统治者而保留结构的做法。

senses.title: A kingdom as a biological metaphor in teaching
senses.titleCN: 教学中作为生物隐喻的「界」
senses.definition: the use of the rank as a memorable container in museum labels and textbooks, even where the technical scheme has changed
senses.definitionCN: 在博物馆标签与教科书中把这个阶元当作易记容器使用，即使技术方案已经改变
senses.example: The display still says kingdom although the guide uses domains.
senses.exampleCN: 展签仍写着界，尽管讲解员用的是域。
senses.why: Labels change slowly because the word is vivid; a kingdom is a place one can imagine entering, while a domain is an abstraction.
senses.whyCN: 标签变得很慢，因为这个词生动：界是一个可以想象走进去的地方，而域是抽象概念。

intro.en: Kingdom is a native English compound of cyning 'king' and -dom 'domain, jurisdiction'; it has no Latin ancestor. The taxonomic sense was added in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: kingdom 是英语本族复合词，由 cyning「国王」与 -dom「领域、管辖」构成，没有拉丁语祖先。分类学义在 18 至 19 世纪加入。年代为约数。

items.en: Cyning meant 'king', a word of uncertain deeper origin; it is not related to Latin rex, which is a different stock.
items.cn: cyning 意为「国王」，其更深来源不确定；它与拉丁 rex 无关，二者属不同词源。

items.en: -Dom meant 'state, condition, jurisdiction', as in freedom and wisdom; it made abstract nouns from nouns and adjectives.
items.cn: -dom 意为「状态、境况、管辖」，如 freedom、wisdom；它由名词与形容词构成抽象名词。

items.en: The compound cyningdom passed into Middle English as kingdom with the plain political sense of a ruler's territory.
items.cn: 复合词 cyningdom 进入中古英语作 kingdom，保留「统治者领土」这一朴素政治义。

items.en: Linnaeus used kingdom for the broadest division of nature, and the plant and animal kingdoms became standard school categories.
items.cn: 林奈用 kingdom 指自然界最宽的划分，植物界与动物界成为标准学校类别。

items.en: Molecular data later placed the kingdoms under three domains, so the rank lost its position at the top.
items.cn: 分子数据后来把各界归入三个域之下，这个阶元因此失去顶端位置。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Old-English origin of cyning is unsettled, and the date when kingdom first replaced the older compound in taxonomy is not fixed here.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：cyning 在古英语之前的来源无定论；kingdom 在分类学中首次取代旧复合词的确切年代此处无法确定。

note.en: Group one separates words built on king; group two compares the ranks around kingdom and its figurative relatives.
note.cn: 第一组区分建立在 king 之上的词；第二组比较界周围的阶元及其比喻性亲属。

entries.definition: The ruler whose territory is the kingdom. The -dom suffix is what turns the person into the realm.
entries.definitionCN: 其领土即王国的统治者。-dom 后缀正是把人变成领域的那一部分。

entries.definition: The position or dignity of a king, built with -ship. It names the role, not the territory.
entries.definitionCN: 国王的地位或尊严，由 -ship 构成。它指角色，而非领土。

entries.definition: Royal or majestic, built with -ly. It describes bearing, not a place.
entries.definitionCN: 王者的、威严的，由 -ly 构成。它描述气度，而非地点。

entries.definition: Relatives by blood, from Old English cynn 'family'. It looks like kingdom but has no -dom and no territory.
entries.definitionCN: 血亲，来自古英语 cynn「家族」。外形像 kingdom，却没有 -dom，也没有领土。

entries.definition: In the three-domain scheme, the rank above kingdom; the word also means any sphere of control.
entries.definitionCN: 三域方案中位于界之上的阶元；这个词也指任何管辖范围。

entries.definition: The rank below kingdom, grouping classes that share a body plan.
entries.definitionCN: 界之下的阶元，把共享身体构型的纲聚合起来。

entries.definition: A kingdom or a sphere of activity, from Latin regalis through French. It is the literary twin of kingdom.
entries.definitionCN: 王国或活动领域，经法语来自拉丁 regalis。它是 kingdom 的文学性同义词。

entries.definition: A group of territories under one sovereign, larger than a kingdom and often assembled by conquest.
entries.definitionCN: 一个君主统治下的多片领土，大于王国，常由征服组合而成。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: cyning 'king' + -dom 'jurisdiction': a kingdom is the area a king holds.
normal.cn: cyning「国王」+ -dom「管辖」：王国就是国王所辖之地。

normal.en: The taxonomic rank is the widest container: kingdom, then phylum, class and so on down.
normal.cn: 分类阶元中最宽的容器：界，然后门、纲，一路向下。

normal.en: Five kingdoms were standard for much of the twentieth century; three domains later took the top.
normal.cn: 五界在 20 世纪大部分时间是标准；后来三域占了顶端。

normal.en: The animal kingdom is the phrase that carries the rank into ordinary speech.
normal.cn: 动物界是把这一阶元带进日常语言的那个短语。

normal.en: Kingdom of God and kingdom of ends are older uses of the same political image.
normal.cn: 天国与目的王国是同一政治意象更早的用法。

abstract.en: Picture a walled country where one name is cut into the gate.
abstract.cn: 想象一个有城墙的国家，城门上刻着一个名字。

abstract.en: Picture a territory whose border is drawn by a constitution rather than by a person.
abstract.cn: 想象一片边界由宪法而非由人划出的领土。

abstract.en: Picture a museum hall labelled as a realm, as if a visitor could walk into it.
abstract.cn: 想象一间被标成一个国度的展厅，仿佛参观者可以走进去。

examples.en: The kingdom was divided among three heirs within a generation.
examples.cn: 这个王国在一代人之内被三位继承人分割。

examples.en: Fungi were once placed in the plant kingdom and later given their own.
examples.cn: 真菌曾被放进植物界，后来有了自己的界。

examples.en: The exhibition label still uses the older kingdom scheme.
examples.cn: 展签仍沿用较早的界方案。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「king 国王 + dom 领域」——国王管的这片地方 → kingdom 王国；界

root: 英语本族复合词：古英语 cyning「国王」+ -dom「领域、管辖」；无拉丁语祖先。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of kingdom move from a monarch's land to the broadest taxonomic rank, the five-kingdom system, its demotion under domains, figurative realms, the animal kingdom of popular speech, the Kingdom of God, Kant's kingdom of ends and the persistent museum label.
sensesIntro.cn: kingdom 的九个义项从君主的土地走到最宽的分类阶元、五界系统、在域之下被降级、比喻性的国度、通俗语中的动物界、天国、康德的目的王国，以及迟迟不改的展签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bordered realm under one name, whether a king's land or a whole branch of life.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个在一个名称之下、有边界的领域，无论是国王的土地还是一整支生命。

branches.en: THE POLITICAL SHAPE: a bordered realm under one rule, kept even when the ruler is removed.
branches.cn: 政治形状：一个在一个统治之下、有边界的领域，即使去掉统治者仍保留。

branches.en: THE RANK AND ITS POPULAR LIFE: the widest biological container, vivid enough to survive technical change.
branches.cn: 阶元与它的通俗生命：最宽的生命容器，生动到能熬过技术变更。

branches.en: THE FIVE KINGDOMS: the twentieth-century standard arrangement.
branches.cn: 五界：20 世纪的标准安排。

branches.en: THE DEMOTION: molecular data placed domains above kingdoms.
branches.cn: 降级：分子数据把域放到界之上。

branches.en: THE OLDER REALMS: divine rule and a community of ends use the same image without a monarch.
branches.cn: 更古老的领域：神的统治与目的共同体使用同一意象而不设君主。

intro.en: Kingdom is a native English word whose two parts are both old and transparent; its biological sense is a later borrowing of the political image.
intro.cn: kingdom 是英语本族词，两个部分都古老而透明；其生物学义是后来借用政治意象的结果。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin ancestor: king and -dom are native Germanic stock, so latinEntries is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语祖先：king 与 -dom 都是本族日耳曼词素，因此拉丁同族词条列表留空。

items.example: Cyning is the person; the suffix makes the place.
items.exampleCN: cyning 是人，后缀造成地点。

items.example: The suffix is the same one heard in freedom.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀也见于 freedom。

items.example: The kingdom is the area, not the person.
items.exampleCN: kingdom 指领域，不指人。

items.example: King names the ruler of the realm.
items.exampleCN: king 指领域的统治者。

items.example: Kingship is the role, kingdom the land.
items.exampleCN: kingship 是角色，kingdom 是土地。

items.example: Kingly describes bearing rather than borders.
items.exampleCN: kingly 描述气度而非边界。

items.example: Kindred is a false look-alike, with no -dom.
items.exampleCN: kindred 是形近假朋友，不含 -dom。

items.example: Realm is the Latin-derived twin of kingdom.
items.exampleCN: realm 是 kingdom 的拉丁来源同义词。

items.example: The domain now sits above the kingdom.
items.exampleCN: 域如今位于界之上。

definition_zh: 领域；域（生物分类最高阶元）；域名；定义域；领地；结构域；论域
definition_en: an area of activity, control or knowledge, or the highest rank in the three-domain classification of life
core_image: 一位研究者在自己的书桌前工作了三十年，别的领域的问题也常被送到这张桌上
scene: 一位研究者在自己的领域里工作了三十年，别的学科的问题也常被送到他的桌前。 A researcher worked for thirty years within his own domain, and questions from other fields were often brought to his desk.
sceneCN: 这里 domain 是「领域」（第 1 个义项：活动或知识的范围）；句意：一位研究者在自己的领域里工作了三十年，别的学科的问题也常被送到他的桌前。

pos.zh: 领域；域（生物分类）；域名；定义域；领地；结构域；论域

senses.title: A sphere of activity or knowledge
senses.definition: an area of work, study or responsibility that a person or group occupies
senses.definitionCN: 个人或群体所从事的工作、研究或职责范围
senses.example: The researcher worked for thirty years within his own domain.
senses.exampleCN: 这位研究者在自己的领域里工作了三十年。
senses.why: Latin dominium meant 'ownership, lordship'; a domain is first a place where one has authority, then any area one treats as one's own.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 dominium 意为「所有权、主权」；领域首先是某人有权力的地方，后指某人视作自己地盘的任何范围。

senses.title: The highest rank: domain
senses.definition: in the three-domain scheme, the rank above kingdom, based on fundamental differences in cell type
senses.definitionCN: 三域方案中位于界之上的阶元，依据细胞类型的根本差异划分
senses.example: The three-domain scheme placed the archaea in a domain of their own.
senses.exampleCN: 三域方案把古菌放进它们自己的一个域。
senses.why: Molecular data showed two deeply different prokaryotic groups, so the top of the ladder needed a new name; domain, the word for jurisdiction, was available.
senses.whyCN: 分子数据显出两个差异极深的原核类群，梯子顶端因此需要新名称；表示管辖范围的 domain 正好可用。

senses.title: An internet domain name
senses.definition: the registered address of a website or service, made of a name and a top-level suffix
senses.definitionCN: 网站或服务注册的地址，由一个名称与顶级后缀构成
senses.example: The domain was registered before the product had a name.
senses.exampleCN: 在产品还没有名字之前，域名就已注册。
senses.why: The internet borrowed the word for a bounded address space: whoever holds the name governs that corner of the network, exactly as a lord governs a domain.
senses.whyCN: 互联网借用这个词来指一个有边界的地址空间：持有名称者管辖网络的这个角落，正如领主管辖领地。

senses.title: The domain of a mathematical function
senses.definition: the set of input values for which a function is defined
senses.definitionCN: 使函数有定义的输入值的集合
senses.example: The domain excludes zero, where the function has no value.
senses.exampleCN: 定义域排除零，因为函数在零处无定义。
senses.why: Mathematics kept the 'area of authority' image in a precise form: the domain is where the function is allowed to act.
senses.whyCN: 数学以精确形式保留了「权辖范围」的意象：定义域就是函数被允许起作用的地方。

senses.title: Eminent domain in law
senses.definition: the power of the state to take private property for public use, with compensation
senses.definitionCN: 国家为公共用途、在给予补偿的前提下取得私有财产的权力
senses.example: The city used eminent domain to acquire the strip of land.
senses.exampleCN: 市政府用征用权取得了那条狭长土地。
senses.why: Law made the lordship literal: the state's ultimate domain over land can override a private owner, provided compensation is paid.
senses.whyCN: 法律把领主权字面化：国家对土地的终极管辖可以压过私人所有者，前提是给予补偿。

senses.title: A feudal domain or demesne
senses.definition: land held and governed by a lord, especially the portion kept for his own use
senses.definitionCN: 由领主拥有并治理的土地，尤指保留自用的那部分
senses.example: The manor's domain supplied the household with grain.
senses.exampleCN: 庄园的领地供给这个家户粮食。
senses.why: This is the oldest concrete sense: land a lord holds and rules, from which the abstract senses of ownership and sphere later grew.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的具体义：领主拥有并治理的土地；所有权与范围的抽象义后来由此生长。

senses.title: A protein domain
senses.definition: a compact, independently folding part of a protein that performs a specific function
senses.definitionCN: 蛋白质中能独立折叠、执行特定功能的紧凑部分
senses.example: The kinase domain binds the phosphate donor.
senses.exampleCN: 激酶结构域结合磷酸供体。
senses.why: Structural biology borrowed the word for a self-governing part: a domain folds on its own and can be moved between proteins, like a small territory with its own rule.
senses.whyCN: 结构生物学借用这个词来指一个自治的部分：结构域自行折叠，还能在蛋白质之间搬移，像一片自有规则的小领地。

senses.title: A security or administrative domain in computing
senses.titleCN: 计算机中的安全域或管理域
senses.definition: a bounded area of a network or system governed by one set of access rules
senses.definitionCN: 由一套访问规则管辖的网络或系统区域
senses.example: No account may cross from one domain to another without a new login.
senses.exampleCN: 没有新的登录，任何账户都不得从一个域越到另一个域。
senses.why: Computing reused the political model directly: one administrator, one rule set, one boundary that traffic must not cross freely.
senses.whyCN: 计算机直接沿用这个政治模型：一个管理员、一套规则、一条流量不得随意越过的边界。

senses.title: The domain of discourse in logic
senses.definition: the set of individuals over which a quantifier ranges in a logical statement
senses.definitionCN: 逻辑陈述中量词所涵盖的个体集合
senses.example: The sentence is true only within the domain of discourse specified.
senses.exampleCN: 这句话只在所指定的论域内为真。
senses.why: Logic needed a name for the range a statement speaks about, and the domain supplied it: whatever falls outside is simply not being discussed.
senses.whyCN: 逻辑学需要为陈述所谈的范围取一个名称，domain 提供了它：落在范围之外的东西，根本没有被讨论。

intro.en: Domain comes from Latin dominium 'ownership, lordship', built on dominus 'master' and domus 'house'. It entered English through French. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: domain 来自拉丁 dominium「所有权、主权」，由 dominus「主人」与 domus「房屋」构成，经法语进入英语。年代为约数。

items.en: Domus meant 'house, household'. It is the oldest layer: a domain begins as the house a master rules.
items.cn: domus 意为「房屋、家户」。它是最古老的一层：领地最初就是主人所治的家宅。

items.en: Dominus meant 'master, lord', from domus; it produced dominate, dominion and dominus in ecclesiastical use.
items.cn: dominus 意为「主人、领主」，出自 domus；它产生 dominate、dominion，并在教会用语中保留 dominus。

items.en: Dominium meant 'ownership, property, sovereignty', and Medieval Latin extended it to a lord's land.
items.cn: dominium 意为「所有权、财产、主权」，中世纪拉丁语把它扩展到领主的土地。

items.en: Old French domaine brought the word into English with the sense of a lord's estate, later widened to any sphere.
items.cn: 古法语 domaine 把该词带入英语，义为领主的产业，后扩展到任何范围。

items.en: Mathematics, computing and biology each borrowed the word for a bounded area of authority; Woese's three-domain classification then placed domain above kingdom, giving the old word its highest taxonomic rank.
items.cn: 数学、计算机与生物学各自借用这个词来指有边界的权辖范围；沃斯的三域分类随后把 domain 置于界之上，使这个旧词获得最高的分类阶元位置。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the exact first English use of domain is not fixed here; the link of dominus to domus is generally accepted but the pre-Latin origin of domus is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：domain 最早的英语使用此处无法确定；dominus 与 domus 的联系一般认为是成立的，但 domus 在拉丁语之前的来源属重构。

note.en: Group one separates words built on the Latin domus/dominus stock; group two compares spheres, ranks and territories.
note.cn: 第一组区分同出拉丁 domus／dominus 词干的词；第二组比较范围、阶元与领土。

entries.definition: To control or tower over, from dominari 'to rule'. It names the act of holding a domain.
entries.definitionCN: 支配或高耸于，来自 dominari「统治」。它指持有领域的动作。

entries.definition: Sovereignty or a ruled territory, from dominium. It is the political twin of domain.
entries.definitionCN: 主权或被统治的领土，来自 dominium。它是 domain 的政治同义词。

entries.definition: A small tile used in a game, from dominus by way of the phrase 'lord' used in old game calls; unrelated in meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 游戏用的小牌，经旧时游戏呼语中的「主人」一词来自 dominus；意义上无关。

entries.definition: A lord's own land kept for his use, from dominicum. It is the concrete estate behind the abstract domain.
entries.definitionCN: 领主保留自用的土地，出自 dominicum。它是抽象 domain 背后的具体产业。

entries.definition: A branch of study or an area of practical activity. It is looser than domain and implies no boundary or authority.
entries.definitionCN: 一个研究分支或实践领域。比 domain 宽松，不含边界或权威之意。

entries.definition: The taxonomic rank below domain in the three-domain scheme; each domain contains several kingdoms.
entries.definitionCN: 三域方案中域之下的阶元；每个域包含若干界。

entries.definition: A kingdom or an area of activity, used more in writing than in technical prose.
entries.definitionCN: 王国或活动领域，较多用于写作而非技术文献。

entries.definition: A defined area, often one defended by an animal or claimed by a state; it stresses space more than authority.
entries.definitionCN: 被界定的区域，常由动物防卫或由国家主张；比 domain 更强调空间而非权威。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: dominus 'master' + domus 'house': a domain is where a master's word runs.
normal.cn: dominus「主人」+ domus「房屋」：领域就是主人的话得以施行之处。

normal.en: The technical senses all keep a boundary: a function's inputs, a network's rules, a protein's folded part.
normal.cn: 各技术义都保留一条边界：函数的输入、网络的规则、蛋白质的折叠部分。

normal.en: In the three-domain scheme, domain is now the highest rank, above kingdom.
normal.cn: 在三域方案中，域是最高阶元，位于界之上。

normal.en: A domain name is the corner of the network its holder governs.
normal.cn: 域名就是持有者所管辖的网络角落。

normal.en: Eminent domain is the state's ultimate lordship over land.
normal.cn: 国家征用权是国家对土地的终极领主权。

abstract.en: Picture a study whose door only one person may open, and whose floor is marked at the threshold.
abstract.cn: 想象一间书房，只有一人能开门，门槛上划着界线。

abstract.en: Picture a map divided into lordships, each with its own seal and its own law.
abstract.cn: 想象一张划成若干领地的地图，每片有自己的印与自己的法。

abstract.en: Picture a machine whose parts can be unscrewed and fitted into another machine.
abstract.cn: 想象一台机器的部件可以拆下、装到另一台机器上。

examples.en: The question lies outside my domain, so I sent it to a colleague.
examples.cn: 这个问题超出我的领域，所以我转给了同事。

examples.en: Archaea were given their own domain on the basis of ribosomal sequences.
examples.cn: 古菌依据核糖体序列被给予自己的一个域。

examples.en: The domain name was transferred without changing the site.
examples.cn: 域名被转移，而网站本身没有改变。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「do 做 + main 主要」——主要归我做的那片范围 → domain 领域；域

root: 拉丁 dominium「所有权、主权」，由 dominus「主人」与 domus「房屋」构成；经法语 domaine 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of domain all describe a bounded area under one authority: a scholar's field, the highest taxonomic rank, an internet address, a function's inputs, state taking power, a lord's land, a folded protein part, a network's rule zone and a logical universe of discourse.
sensesIntro.cn: domain 的九个义项都描述一片在一个权属之下、有边界的范围：学者的领域、最高分类阶元、互联网地址、函数的输入、国家征用权、领主的土地、蛋白质折叠部分、网络的规则区域，以及逻辑论域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bounded area where one rule runs, marked at the threshold.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片有边界、由一条规则统辖的区域，门槛上划着界线。

branches.en: THE OLD CORE: a master's house and a lord's land are the concrete origin of every later sense.
branches.cn: 古老核心：主人的家宅与领主的土地，是其后各义的具体源头。

branches.en: THE WIDEST AND THE FORMAL: biology's top rank and logic's universe of discourse are both total ranges.
branches.cn: 最宽与最形式化：生物学的最高阶元与逻辑学的论域都是总体范围。

branches.en: RULED CORNERS: a domain name and a security domain are network territory with one administrator.
branches.cn: 被管辖的角落：域名与安全域都是有一个管理者的网络领土。

branches.en: SELF-GOVERNING PARTS: a function acts only on its domain, and a protein domain folds on its own.
branches.cn: 自治的部分：函数只在定义域内起作用，蛋白质结构域自行折叠。

branches.en: THE ULTIMATE CLAIM: eminent domain is the state's lordship overriding a private owner.
branches.cn: 终极主张：国家征用权是国家领主权压过私人所有者。

intro.en: Domain is one Latin word for lordship that has been borrowed by every discipline that needs a bounded area of authority.
intro.cn: domain 是一个表示领主权的拉丁词，被每一个需要有界权辖范围的学科借用。

latinIntro.en: Latin domus and dominus give domain, dominate, dominant, dominion, domino and demesne; dominium is the direct source of the English noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 domus 与 dominus 给出 domain、dominate、dominant、dominion、domino、demesne；dominium 是英语名词的直接来源。

items.example: The house is the oldest image of a domain.
items.exampleCN: 家宅是领域最古老的意象。

items.example: Dominus supplies the authority in the word.
items.exampleCN: dominus 提供这个词中的权威。

items.example: Dominium is the direct source of domain.
items.exampleCN: dominium 是 domain 的直接来源。

items.example: A domain has a threshold and a rule.
items.exampleCN: 一个领域有门槛，也有规则。

items.example: To dominate is to hold a domain over others.
items.exampleCN: 支配就是对人持有领域。

items.example: Dominion is the political twin of domain.
items.exampleCN: dominion 是 domain 的政治同义词。

items.example: The demesne is the concrete estate.
items.exampleCN: demesne 是具体的产业。

items.example: Domino shares the root but not the meaning.
items.exampleCN: domino 共用词根，却不共用意义。

items.example: Kingdom now sits below domain.
items.exampleCN: 界如今位于域之下。
